_about: Granite PM Academy per-master prompt overrides. Merged over multisite/ai/archetypes.json by compile.php, then compiled to data/ai_block_types.json. PM-flavored + SEO-tuned: angle-variation, entity-richness (real employers/projects from research), search-intent matching. Tokens available from generate.py build_context: {business} {city} {SS} {state} {service} {keyword} {secondary_keywords} {industries} {top_employers} {salary_note} {market_blurb} {notable_projects} {credential_demand} {website} {phone}. Brief tokens: [[brief.business_descriptor]] [[brief.local_angle]] [[brief.customer_noun]] [[brief.guardrails]] [[shared.tone_line]]. Neighborhood block intentionally omitted (granite trains live-virtual/nationwide; no neighborhood data).

hero_subtext.label: Hero Subtext (Inject)
hero_subtext.description: 2-3 sentence hero subtext, opens on the city's PM market, centers on the page's credential.
hero_subtext.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing hero subtext for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]] (a PMI Authorized Training Partner), for a page targeting "{service}" in {city}, {state}. Write 2-3 sentences, 40-60 words total, wrapped in a single

...

: - Open on something specific to {city}'s project-management market — its dominant industry or a major local employer type — so this opening is not interchangeable with any other city. - Center on {service}: what {business} delivers on this page (live-virtual, instructor-led, satisfies PMI's contact-hour education requirement for this credential). Do NOT list the other certifications offered. - Close with a concrete career value for [[brief.customer_noun]] in {city}. No bullets, no exclamation marks. ACCURACY: [[brief.guardrails]] [[shared.tone_line]] Return JSON only: {"text": "

...

"}

feature_columns_local.label: Feature Columns — Local (Standalone)
feature_columns_local.description: 4 benefit columns: 3 core academy differentiators + 1 city-specific column grounded in local employer demand.
feature_columns_local.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing feature columns for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]] (a PMI Authorized Training Partner), for the "{service}" page targeting {city}, {state}.

Local context (use only what is given): industries = {industries}; major employers = {top_employers}.

fc_heading: 6-10 words, city-aware and benefit-focused (vary the phrasing — do not reuse a stock heading).

Write exactly 4 columns:
- Columns 1-3: real differentiators of {business}'s {service} — PMI Authorized Training Partner status, live-virtual instructor-led format satisfying the contact-hour requirement for this credential, instructors who are active certified practitioners, and exam-preparation support. Choose three distinct angles; do not repeat the same idea.
- Column 4: a {city}-specific benefit — tie the credential to demand among local employers or industries above, grounded in [[brief.local_angle]].

Each column: heading 3-5 words (benefit-focused); text 20-30 words, concrete and non-generic.

ACCURACY: [[brief.guardrails]]
[[shared.tone_line]]

local_relevance.label: Local Career Relevance (Standalone)
local_relevance.description: Entity-rich section: which local employers/projects hire certified PMs, salary/demand context — the anti-doorway block.
local_relevance.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing a local career-relevance section for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]], for the "{service}" page targeting {city}, {state}. This is the most city-specific section on the page — it must not read like it could describe any other city. ...

: - Para 1: Who hires certified project managers in {city}. No bullets. If a fact above is blank, simply omit it — do not fill the gap with an invented specific. pmp_pathway.label: Certification Pathway (Standalone, steps)
pmp_pathway.description: 5-step path to the credential (eligibility → contact hours → application → exam → maintenance), framed for the target city.
pmp_pathway.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing a step-by-step certification pathway for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]] (a PMI Authorized Training Partner), for the "{service}" page targeting {city}, {state}.

steps_heading: 5-9 words, references the path to {service} for {city} professionals.

Write exactly 5 steps that reflect the real PMI process for this credential:
1. Confirm eligibility (the education + project-experience requirements PMI sets for this credential).
2. Complete the required 35 contact hours of formal education — delivered by {business}'s live-virtual, instructor-led course.
3. Submit the PMI application and pay the exam fee.
4. Prepare and sit for the exam — with {business}'s exam-preparation support.
5. Maintain the credential (earning PDUs across the standard 3-year renewal cycle).

Each step: heading 3-6 words; text 25-40 words, practical and specific to the reader's next action. You may only state well-established PMI facts (e.g. the 35 contact-hour requirement, the 3-year renewal cycle). Do not invent exam fees, pass rates, or timelines.

ACCURACY: [[brief.guardrails]]
[[shared.tone_line]]

Return JSON only: {"steps_heading": "...", "steps_items": [{"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}]}

faq_local.label: FAQ — Local (Inject, append)
faq_local.description: Appends 4 city-specific FAQ items to the next faq_two_col block, alongside the real factual FAQs kept in the template.
faq_local.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing city-specific FAQ items for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]], for the "{service}" page targeting {city}, {state}. These are ADDED to existing general FAQs, so ask only questions a {city} professional would search that are specific to their local market — do NOT repeat generic eligibility/format/pricing questions. Local context (use only what is given): major employers = {top_employers}; compensation note = {salary_note}; credential demand = {credential_demand}; industries = {industries}. Write exactly 4 FAQ items. Suggested angles (pick 4 distinct ones): is {service} worth it for careers in {city}; which {city} employers or industries value the credential; what project managers in {city} typically earn (qualitative only); whether {city} professionals can attend the live-virtual course from where they work; how the local job market affects certification timing. Each item: - question: specific and searchable, 8-15 words; at least half naturally include "{city}". - answer: 40-70 words, grounded in the real context above, wrapped in

...

. Never fabricate a salary figure, pass rate, price, or employer. Optionally, at most ONE question may naturally use a long-tail variant phrasing if it genuinely fits — never force it, never list them, and keep the primary focus intact: {secondary_keywords}. ACCURACY: [[brief.guardrails]] [[shared.tone_line]] Return JSON only: {"items": [{"question": "...", "answer": "

...

"}, ... 4 items total]}

capm_pathway.label: CAPM Certification Pathway (Standalone, steps)
capm_pathway.description: 5-step path to the CAPM (eligibility w/ no experience → 23 contact hours → application → exam → maintenance), framed for the target city.
capm_pathway.prompt_skeleton:
You are writing a step-by-step CAPM certification pathway for {business}, [[brief.business_descriptor]] (a PMI Authorized Training Partner), for the "{service}" page targeting {city}, {state}.

steps_heading: 5-9 words, references the path to CAPM certification for {city} professionals.

Write exactly 5 steps that reflect the real PMI process for the CAPM credential:
1. Confirm eligibility — the CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or global equivalent) and 23 hours of project management education. Emphasize that NO prior work experience is required, which makes CAPM ideal for those newer to project management.
2. Complete the required 23 contact hours of education — delivered by {business}'s live-virtual, instructor-led course (an intensive boot-camp-style format).
3. Submit the PMI application and pay the exam fee.
4. Prepare and sit for the CAPM exam — with {business}'s exam-preparation support.
5. Maintain the credential — earn professional development units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle.

Each step: heading 3-6 words; text 25-40 words, practical and specific to the reader's next action. You may only state well-established PMI facts (e.g. the 23 contact-hour requirement, no experience required, the three-year renewal cycle). Do not invent exam fees, pass rates, or timelines.

ACCURACY: [[brief.guardrails]]
[[shared.tone_line]]

Return JSON only: {"steps_heading": "...", "steps_items": [{"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}, {"heading": "...", "text": "..."}]}
